subject: maths
question: 400 apples were bought at ₹1240 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹840. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of apples.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP for 400 apples = 4 × 1240 = ₹4960

Total SP = CP + Profit = 4960 + 840 = ₹5800

SP of 1 dozen = (Total SP ÷ Total Apples) × 12

SP of 1 dozen = (5800 ÷ 400) × 12 = 14.50 × 12 = 174

**∴ The correct answer is ₹174.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total apples bought = 400

Cost price of 100 apples = ₹1240

Total profit earned = ₹840

**Formula Used:**

Total Selling Price (SP) = Total Cost Price (CP) + Profit

SP per dozen = (Total SP ÷ Total Quantity) × 12
